label: AgMsv_1.968

aiśe mantreśavargasthitir atha suśive dhāmni tannāthaniṣṭhā pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ ca tatra prakaṭayati nijāṃ mātṛmānavyavasthām /

quick_english: In the Īśa domain abides the class of Mantreśas; now, in the most auspicious abode, devotion to that Lord — and each prior stage therein reveals its own order of knower and measure — so that, with no other knower, the self-luminous state of Śiva flashes forth ever one; yet from the Mantreśa-Īśas issue divisions numbered three, five, seven, nine, and three.

label: AgMsv_1.969
cite_parts:
śaktiś ca no śaktimato vibhinnā tenaiti no bhedam iyaṃ pṛthaktvam /
amātṛtāyāṃ na ca śaktir asti tena svarūpaṃ na hi śaktiyuktam // [AgMsv_1.969]
quick_english: And śakti, for our part, is undivided from the power-holder; thereby this separateness does not indeed amount to difference. Where knowerhood is absent, moreover, no śakti exists — so such a nature is not endowed with power.

label: AgMsv_1.971

dharātattvagataṃ yogam abhyasya śivavidyayā // [AgMsv_1.972]

quick_english: But not like the dualists — Pāśava, Sāṃkhya, Vaiṣṇava and the rest — who, never attaining the firm abode, possess but vijñānākala-nature.

label: AgMsv_1.974

tāvattattvopabhogena ye kalpānte layaṃ gatāḥ /
sauṣuptāvasthitau yadvat te 'tra pralayakevalāḥ // [AgMsv_1.974]
quick_english: Those who, through enjoyment of just such principles, reached dissolution at the kalpas end — abiding as in deep sleep, they are here the pralayakevalas.

label: AgMsv_1.975
cite_parts:
sauṣupte tattvalīnatvaṃ sphuṭam eva hi lakṣyate /
anyathā niyatasvapnasaṃsṛṣṭir iyatī kutaḥ // [AgMsv_1.975]
quick_english: In deep sleep the dissolvedness in the principles is indeed plainly seen — for otherwise, whence this fixed conjunction with dreaming, just so?

sauṣuptam api citraṃ ca svacchāsvacchādi bhāsate /
asvāpsaṃ sukham ityādismṛtivaicitryadarśanāt // [AgMsv_1.976]

māyākarmasamullāsasaṃmiśritamalābilāḥ /
dharādhirohiṇo jñeyāḥ sakalā iha pudgalāḥ // [AgMsv_1.977]
quick_english: Here the persons, whose massed malas mix with the upsurge of māyā and karma, climbing upon earth, are to be known as sakalas.

asyaiva saptakasya svasvavyāpāraprakalpane /

label: AgMsv_1.981

tatsvarūpaṃ tatas traidhaṃ pratitattvaṃ vyavasthitam /
kiṃ cārthe khalu nirgrāhye tuṭayaḥ ṣoḍaśa kṣaṇāḥ // [AgMsv_1.981]
quick_english: Its nature is therefore settled threefold, per tattva; and in the ungraspable object — what? — the sixteen tuṭis are moments.

label: AgMsv_1.982
cite_parts:
sapādadvyaṅgulāveśāt pratyekaṃ parikalpitāḥ /
tatrādyaḥ paramādvaitanirvibhāgarasātmakaḥ // [AgMsv_1.982]

upāntyas tatsvarūpasya grāhakaḥ paribhāvvyate // [AgMsv_1.983]

dvitīyaṃ saptakaṃ tatra parāparapadātmakam // [AgMsv_1.985]
quick_english: For the wise know that very nature as Śiva consisting of supreme śakti; the second seven therein consists of the parāpara plane.

label: AgMsv_1.986

quick_english: Sung as vikalpa — thus difference is made to appear; for that, in this subtle consciousness, they are intent on impelling.

tokens.grounds: visarga to o before voiced consonant

saṃvedayante yadrūpaṃ tatra kiṃ vā vikatthanaiḥ /

quick_english: Whatever form they experience — what is there in boastings about it? But what is held: even the tuṭis, in the lessening of difference that comes from sequence.

tokens.grounds: causative of vid to make known 3pl middle

label: AgMsv_1.988
cite_parts:
vikalpasya ca nirhrāso nirvikalpopalakṣaṇam /
yathā hi ciraduḥkhārtaḥ paścād āttasukhasthitiḥ // [AgMsv_1.988]
quick_english: The diminution of conceptualization is characterized by the absence of conceptualization, just as one afflicted by long suffering later attains a state of happiness.

label: AgMsv_1.989
cite_parts:
vismaraty eva tadduḥkhaṃ sukhaviśrāntivartmanā /
tathā gatavikalpe 'pi rūḍhāḥ saṃvedane janāḥ // [AgMsv_1.989]
quick_english: Just as someone who has found happiness forgets earlier suffering by resting in that happiness, so people who are firmly established in awareness, even when conceptual thought has gone, no longer cling to it.

tokens.grounds: instrumental of the way of repose in pleasure
state where conceptual thought has departed

label: AgMsv_1.990
cite_parts:
vikalpaviśrāntibalāt tāṃ vṛttiṃ nābhimanvate /

vikalpanirhrāsavaśena yāti vikalpavandhyā paramārthasatyā /
saṃvitsvarūpaprakaṭatvam itthaṃ tatrāvadhāne yatatāṃ subuddhiḥ // [AgMsv_1.990]
quick_english: People who rely on conceptual thinking do not lay claim to that deeper state; but when conceptualization dissolves, awareness becomes free of thought and ultimately true, and its own nature shines forth. In this way, clear understanding arises for those who attend to it with effort.

tokens.grounds: power arising from reliance on thought
refers to the non-conceptual state or awareness
do not appropriate or identify with
through the fading away of thought
the becoming manifest of awareness's own nature
in focused attention on that state

label: AgMsv_1.991
cite_parts:
grāhyagrāhakasaṃvittau saṃbandhe sāvadhānatā /
iyaṃ sā bhaṇyate tatra yatheṣṭaphalayogataḥ // [AgMsv_1.991]
quick_english: This attentiveness is said to occur in the relation between the grasped, the grasper, and their awareness, because in that context it is connected with the attainment of the desired result.

tokens.grounds: in the cognition involving object and subject
because it yields the intended result

label: AgMsv_1.992
cite_parts:
ata eva hi tadbhedabāhulyād bhuvanāny api /
vicitratvaṃ prayāntīti na cātikrama iṣyate // [AgMsv_1.992]
quick_english: For this very reason, because of the abundance of its divisions, the worlds too become variegated; and no transgression of this explanation is accepted.

tokens.grounds: because of the multiplicity of distinctions within it
and no violation of this principle

label: AgMsv_1.993
cite_parts:
sakramākramam evedaṃ kālasya prākpradūsaṇāt /
diśaś ca paramārthatvaṃ naiva yuktyopapadyate // [AgMsv_1.993]
quick_english: This reality appears both with sequence and without sequence; but since time has already been refuted, and since the ultimate reality of space cannot be established by reasoning, neither can be taken as ultimately real.

tokens.grounds: because time has already been criticized

label: AgMsv_1.994
cite_parts:
pūrvāparapratītiṃ hi naikā sā kurute tathā /
upādhibhedo no vastu tat kathaṃ sā prakalpyatām // [AgMsv_1.994]
quick_english: For no single thing produces the cognition of before and after, and difference based on limiting conditions is not itself a real entity; so how could that cognition be postulated as ultimately grounded?

label: AgMsv_1.995
cite_parts:
yo hi yasmādguṇotkṛṣṭa ity ataḥ parameśvaraḥ /
abhāṣata nijānandakḷptadikkālamaṇḍalaḥ // [AgMsv_1.995]
quick_english: The supreme Lord, who fashions the sphere of space and time out of his own bliss, declared the basis on which one thing is said to be superior to another by its qualities.

tokens.grounds: whose domain of space and time is created by his own bliss

label: AgMsv_1.996
cite_parts:
tad evaṃ tattvarūpe 'smin vicitre pravivikṣatām /
upāyabhedāt traividhyaṃ samāveśeṣu varṇitam // [AgMsv_1.996]
quick_english: Thus, for those who wish to enter into this variegated nature of reality, a threefold division of absorptions has been described, because the means differ.

tokens.grounds: in the true nature of reality
for those desiring to enter deeply

label: AgMsv_1.997
cite_parts:
anupāyaḥ śāṃbhavo 'sau cidupāyas tataḥ param /
jaḍopāyas tv āṇavaḥ syāt sa cāpi bahudhā mataḥ // [AgMsv_1.997]
quick_english: The Śāmbhava means is without method; next comes the means based on consciousness; and the Āṇava means, based on the inert, is also regarded as taking many forms.

tokens.grounds: the means based on the inert

label: AgMsv_1.998
cite_parts:
ajaḍe 'pi jaḍābhāsaḥ pārameśvaryayogataḥ /
nāḍīkaraṇabāhyādes tena saṃvidupāyatā // [AgMsv_1.998]
quick_english: Even within what is non-inert, an appearance of inertness arises through the power of the supreme Lord, as in the channels, senses, and external supports; therefore these can still function as a means grounded in consciousness.

tokens.grounds: in what is conscious or non-material
through the power of the supreme Lord
from nāḍīs, organs, and external supports
its functioning as a means through consciousness

label: AgMsv_1.999
cite_parts:
tatrākṣavṛttim āśritya bāhyākāragraho hi yaḥ /
tajjāgratsphuṭam āsīnam anubandhi punaḥ punaḥ // [AgMsv_1.999]
quick_english: When experience rests on the functioning of the senses and there is a grasping of external forms, that clear and repeatedly continuous condition is the waking state.

tokens.grounds: the operation of the sense faculties
that is the clear waking state

label: AgMsv_1.1000
cite_parts:
ātmasaṃkalpanirmāṇaṃ svapno jāgradviparyayaḥ /
layākalasya yo bhogaḥ layakarmavaśān na tu // [AgMsv_1.1000]
quick_english: Dream is a construction made by one's own imagination and is the reverse of waking; and the experience belonging to the layākala arises under the force of karma tending toward dissolution, but not in a stable way.

tokens.grounds: fabrication produced by one's own mental projection
of the limited subject in dissolution
under the power of karma tending toward dissolution

label: AgMsv_1.1001
cite_parts:
sthiro bhaven niśābhāvāt suptaṃ saukhyādyavedane /
jñānākalasya malataḥ kevalād bhogamātrataḥ // [AgMsv_1.1001]
quick_english: That experience would not be stable, because there is no night-like obscuration; deep sleep is the non-awareness of pleasure and so on. For the jñānākala, due to mere impurity, there is only bare experience.

tokens.grounds: because there is no night-like obscuration
in the absence of awareness of pleasure etc.
of the limited subject with knowledge obscured

label: AgMsv_1.1002
cite_parts:
bhedavantaḥ svato bhinnāś cikīrṣyante jaḍājaḍāḥ /
turye tatra sthitā mantratannāthādhīśvarās trayaḥ // [AgMsv_1.1002]
quick_english: Inert and non-inert things appear as inherently distinct and differentiated; yet in the fourth state there abide the three groups: the mantra beings, their lords, and the overlords.

tokens.grounds: the mantra beings, their lords, and the overlords

label: AgMsv_1.1003
cite_parts:
yāvad bhairavabodhāṃśapraveśanasahiṣṇavaḥ /
bhāvā vigaladātmīyasārāḥ svayam abhedinaḥ // [AgMsv_1.1003]
quick_english: To the extent that entities become capable of receiving a share of Bhairava-awareness, their own separate essence melts away and they become non-different by themselves.

tokens.grounds: able to admit entry into a portion of Bhairava-consciousness

label: AgMsv_1.1004
cite_parts:
turyātītapade saṃsyur iti pañcadaśātmake /
yasya yad yad sphuṭaṃ rūpaṃ taj jāgrad iti manyatām // [AgMsv_1.1004]
quick_english: They would abide in the state beyond the fourth. In this fifteenfold scheme, whatever form appears clear and distinct should be regarded as the waking state.

label: AgMsv_1.1005
cite_parts:
tad evāsthiram ābhāti svarūpaṃ svapna īdṛśaḥ /
asphuṭaṃ tu yad ābhāti suptaṃ tat tat puro 'pi yat // [AgMsv_1.1005]
quick_english: That same form, when it appears unstable, is dream of that kind; but when it appears unclear, that is deep sleep, including what appears before it.

label: AgMsv_1.1006
cite_parts:
tritayasyānusaṃdhis tu yadvaśād upajāyate /
sraksūtratulyaṃ tatturyaṃ sarvabhedeṣu gṛhyatām // [AgMsv_1.1006]
quick_english: The continuity by which the three states arise and are held together, like the thread in a garland, should be understood as the fourth state present through all differences.

tokens.grounds: the continuity linking the three states
like the string running through a garland

label: AgMsv_1.1007
cite_parts:
yat tv advaitabharollāsi drāvitāśeṣabhedakam /
turyātītaṃ tu tat prāhur itthaṃ sarvatra yojayet // [AgMsv_1.1007]
quick_english: But that which shines with the fullness of nonduality and melts away all distinctions is declared to be the state beyond the fourth; one should apply this understanding everywhere.

tokens.grounds: radiant with the plenitude of nonduality

label: AgMsv_1.1008
cite_parts:
layākale hi svaṃ rūpaṃ jāgrattatpūrvavṛtti tu /
svapnādīti kramaṃ sarvaṃ sarvatrānusared budhaḥ // [AgMsv_1.1008]
quick_english: For the layākala, its own form is waking, and the prior states are counted as dream and so on; the wise person should trace this whole sequence in every case.

tokens.grounds: in the case of the layākala subject
waking together with the preceding states
counted as dream and so on
one should follow in all cases

label: AgMsv_1.1009
cite_parts:
ekatrāpi prabhau pūrṇe citturyātītam ucyate /
ānandas turyam icchaiva bījabhūmiḥ suṣuptatā // [AgMsv_1.1009]
quick_english: Even within the one full Lord, consciousness is said to be the state beyond the fourth, bliss is the fourth, and will itself is the seed-ground corresponding to deep sleep.

tokens.grounds: consciousness as the state beyond the fourth

label: AgMsv_1.1010
cite_parts:
jñānaṃ tu svapnavṛttitvaṃ kriyā jāgrad iti smṛtā /
atraiva yogabhūmyutthāḥ saṃjñāḥ piṇḍasthatādayaḥ // [AgMsv_1.1010]
quick_english: Knowledge corresponds to the dream state, and action is remembered as the waking state; in this same context arise the yogic designations beginning with piṇḍastha.

label: AgMsv_1.1011
cite_parts:
sarvatobhadratādyās tu prasaṃkhyājñāninirmitāḥ /
ekaikatra catūrūpasadbhāvād vitate tataḥ // [AgMsv_1.1011]
quick_english: Classifications such as sarvatobhadra are constructed by those who rely on discriminative analysis; because the fourfold structure is present in each case, further elaborations arise in the expanded scheme.

tokens.grounds: formed by those who rely on reflective enumeration
because the fourfold structure is present

label: AgMsv_1.1012
cite_parts:
catūrūpatvam ekatra tritvaṃ paścād athaikatā /
ekas tu bhairavo nāthaḥ prollasadviśvarūpakaḥ // [AgMsv_1.1012]
quick_english: In one place there is fourfoldness, then threefoldness, then oneness; yet the one Lord Bhairava remains, with all universal forms flashing forth within him.

tokens.grounds: whose universal forms are vividly manifest

label: AgMsv_1.1013
cite_parts:
ekaḥ śivādisakalaparyantasthitisaṃgataḥ /
so 'yaṃ samasta evādhvā bhairavābhedavṛttimān // [AgMsv_1.1013]
quick_english: The one reality, present in every state from Śiva to the limited individual, is this entire path itself, abiding in non-difference from Bhairava.

tokens.grounds: compound spanning the whole range of existence
possessing the state of identity with Bhairava

label: AgMsv_1.1014
cite_parts:
tatsvātantryāt svatantratvam aśnuvāno 'vabhāsate /
so 'yaṃ mātṛsvarūpastho mantrādhveti vibhāvyate // [AgMsv_1.1014]
quick_english: By its own freedom, that same reality shines forth as autonomous; when it abides in the form of the knowing subject, it is recognized as the path of mantras.

tokens.grounds: situated in the subject's own form
identified as the mantra path; iti fused

label: AgMsv_1.1015
cite_parts:
pramārūpatayā so 'yaṃ varṇādhveti nirucyate /
pramāṇarūpatām etya prayāty eṣa padādhvatām // [AgMsv_1.1015]
quick_english: In the form of valid cognition, this reality is called the path of phonemes; when it takes the form of the means of knowledge, it becomes the path of words.

tokens.grounds: in the mode of knowledge itself
identified as the phoneme path; iti fused
the form of the instrument of cognition
the condition of being the word path

label: AgMsv_1.1016

quick_english: Therefore, the awareness of one's own consciousness appears here as birth; but beforehand consciousness does not appear in a form suited to its freedom.

label: AgMsv_1.1068
cite_parts:
prāktanī saṃvid eveha pūrvakarmeti bhāṣyate /
tatsaṃvidbādhikā saṃvitkarmakṣayakarī tataḥ // [AgMsv_1.1068]
quick_english: Here the former consciousness is called previous karma; therefore, a consciousness that obstructs that former consciousness brings about the destruction of karma.

label: AgMsv_1.1069
cite_parts:
akṛtaṃ ca yathā svapne mayā kṛtam iti sphuret /
phaladā dṛśyate saiva vārtā jāgrati karmaṇaḥ // [AgMsv_1.1069]
quick_english: Just as in a dream something not actually done can flash forth as 'done by me' and be seen to give fruit, the same is true of karma in the waking state.

label: AgMsv_1.1070

quick_english: And so, if even a single higher consciousness arises in someone, consisting in the burning up of the fruit of the mass of past karma, that person does not undergo that fruit.

kiṃ cānyadbahusaṃvitsusphurattvādayaśo yaśaḥ /
bhūyaḥphalavadākāśanadyambhaḥsiktabījavat // [AgMsv_1.1071]
quick_english: Moreover, through the clear flashing forth of many consciousnesses, even disrepute can become repute, bearing abundant fruit like a seed watered by the waters of a river in the sky.

label: AgMsv_1.1072
cite_parts:
evam alpaphalaṃ karma svalpasaṃvedane sphurat /
asphuran niṣphalaṃ tv eva nyāyaḥ so 'yaṃ svasaṃvidam // [AgMsv_1.1072]
quick_english: Thus karma that flashes forth in slight awareness yields little fruit, while what does not flash forth is indeed fruitless; this is the principle with regard to one's own consciousness.

label: AgMsv_1.1073
cite_parts:
tatrāpy alpatvabhūyastve saṃvidāṃ ye prakalpite /
te karmakartuḥ saṃvittirūḍhyā tadrūpabhāginī // [AgMsv_1.1073]
quick_english: Even there, the smallness or greatness conceived among consciousnesses belongs to the doer of karma and takes that form according to how firmly it is established in consciousness.

tokens.grounds: saṃvit + ti-rūḍhi; instrumental of means as transmitted

label: AgMsv_1.1074
cite_parts:
yā ca (yasya) saṃvit svayaṃ tādṛkphalagarbhā na jāyate /
nāpy anyaphalanirgrāhimātṛsaṃgatitas tathā // [AgMsv_1.1074]
quick_english: And if a consciousness does not arise by itself as pregnant with such a fruit, nor does so through association with a subject grasping another fruit, then that fruit does not arise in that way.

tokens.grounds: anya + phala + nirgrāhi + mātṛ + saṃgati + tas; long compound

label: AgMsv_1.1075
cite_parts:
phalaveditur anyasya pramātur api saṃvidi /
anyapramātṛsaṃkalpād yāvadante sa ko 'py alam // [AgMsv_1.1075]
quick_english: Even in the consciousness of another subject who knows the fruit, who could, to the very end, be capable of determining it through the intention of a different subject?

tokens.grounds: yāvat + anta; locative compound as transmitted

label: AgMsv_1.1076
cite_parts:
prabuddhaḥ sṛṣṭir akṣāyai sthitiśaktivijṛmbhakaḥ /
vidāḥ sma saṃkocayati phalālambanakalpanāḥ // [AgMsv_1.1076]
quick_english: The awakened one, unfolding the power of maintenance in creation, contracts the constructions that are based on grasping at fruit.

label: AgMsv_1.1077

paropakāraṃ kartavyam upādikṣan purātanāḥ // [AgMsv_1.1077]
quick_english: With the understanding that this creation is seen from a vision beyond the fish-like standpoint, the ancients taught that one should help others.

emanation or world-projection; nominative with sandhi

label: AgMsv_1.1078
cite_parts:
evaṃ nāmopakāro 'yaṃ mṛtasyāpi pratanyate /

quick_english: Thus this help is extended even to the dead: through offerings such as rice-balls, union with a body is given again.

tokens.grounds: nāma + upakāra; sandhi fusion in form
adverb of repetition; sandhi before d

label: AgMsv_1.1079

varaṃ svātmani saṃkleśāḥ paraṃ mā pīḍayan tv iti /

quick_english: It is conceived that the fruit of this difficult austerity is the thought: better that afflictions fall upon oneself, but may they not harm others.

tokens.grounds: injunctive or optative-like verbal form as transmitted

label: AgMsv_1.1080
cite_parts:
laśunādāvabhakṣyatvam uktam ājñeya īdṛśī /
akāraṇakam eveti gṛhṇantu kila jantavaḥ // [AgMsv_1.1080]
quick_english: The uneatability of garlic and such things is stated as a command of this kind; people are to accept it, indeed, as without further reason.

tokens.grounds: ā + jñeya; gerundive-related form as transmitted

label: AgMsv_1.1081
cite_parts:
tad evaṃ haṃsapakṣyādibhakṣyābhakṣyatvanirṇaye /
yujyeta bhinnabuddhitvam anyathā nna kathaṃ cana // [AgMsv_1.1081]
quick_english: Therefore, in determining what is eatable or uneatable in cases like swans and other birds, a difference of understanding is fitting; otherwise, it would not be so at all.

tokens.grounds: haṃsa + pakṣin + ādi + bhakṣya + abhakṣyatva + nirṇaya; long compound

label: AgMsv_1.1082

phalayogaḥ sa evādya rūḍhaḥ saṃvidbhuvi sthitaḥ // [AgMsv_1.1082]
quick_english: Thus, in both the seen and the unseen, the connection with fruit, arranged through conceived divisions and sequences, is now firmly established on the ground of consciousness.

tokens.grounds: kalpita + aṃśa + aṃśika + krama; ablative compound

label: AgMsv_1.1083

quick_english: Is the settled view that a body in the other world comes from the rice-ball offering and not otherwise, implying that embodied beings have no mutual connection apart from that?

label: AgMsv_1.1084

quick_english: And by all those masses of scriptures, stakes of doubt were planted; rooted in the ground of ignorant minds, they grew into fixed conclusions about karmic fruit.

label: AgMsv_1.1085
cite_parts:
asti me piṇḍado 'dyāhaṃ piṇḍadānakkramāt tathā /
prapnobh/m(?)yavayavābhogaṃ pūrṇadeho 'smi susthitaḥ // [AgMsv_1.1085]
quick_english: One thinks, 'Today I have someone to offer me rice-balls; through that offering I enjoy my limbs again, and I am whole and well-established.'

label: AgMsv_1.1086
cite_parts:
adṛṣṭakriyayā putraśiṣyasvātmādikḷptayā /
svargabhāgahamatyantamāttasaṃbhogasusthitaḥ // [AgMsv_1.1086]
quick_english: Through unseen rites arranged by a son, disciple, oneself, or others, one imagines having a share in heaven, fully enjoying it and firmly settled there.

label: AgMsv_1.1087
cite_parts:
nāsti me piṇḍadaḥ kaś cit svayaṃ cāsmy atiduṣkṛtī /
na me trātāsti kutrāpi patāmi narakārṇave // [AgMsv_1.1087]
quick_english: One thinks, 'I have no one to offer me rice-balls, I myself have done great wrong, there is no savior for me anywhere, and I am falling into the ocean of hell.'

label: AgMsv_1.1088
cite_parts:
bhaviṣyati mama trātā kvāpi kāle kathaṃ cana /
ityādiḥ saṃvidāṃ sphāras tathaiva phalati svayam // [AgMsv_1.1088]
quick_english: Thoughts like 'Somehow, sometime, I will have a savior' are expansions of awareness, and they bear fruit in just that form by themselves.

label: AgMsv_1.1089
cite_parts:
tasyās tu piṇḍakartrādir mābhūd atha yathā sphuret /
sa tāvat tatphalaṃ bhuṅkte svasaṃkalpena kalpitam // [AgMsv_1.1089]
quick_english: Even if there is no actual person performing the rice-ball rites, one experiences the result exactly as it appears in awareness, fashioned by one's own resolve.

label: AgMsv_1.1090
cite_parts:
śaṅkāvajrapralepāntardṛḍhabaddhāṃ tv imāṃ matim /
bhairavānala evaikaḥ samūlaṃ pluṣyati kṣaṇāt // [AgMsv_1.1090]
quick_english: This belief, tightly sealed within by the diamond-hard plaster of doubt, is burned away root and all in an instant by the fire of Bhairava alone.

label: AgMsv_1.1091
cite_parts:
aśeṣacitracidgarbhasaṃsārasvapnasadmanaḥ /
ploṣakaḥ śiva evāham ityullāsī hutāśanaḥ // [AgMsv_1.1091]
quick_english: The fire that burns up the whole dream-house of the world, contained in all varied consciousness, is the flashing realization, 'I alone am Śiva.'

label: AgMsv_1.1092
cite_parts:
tanmūḍhaḥ karmasaṃvitticitrībhūtacitis tathā /
saṃkalpam eva saṃsāraṃ vicitram abhimanyate // [AgMsv_1.1092]
quick_english: Deluded by that, with consciousness variegated by karmic cognitions, one takes what is really a construction of resolve to be the varied world of transmigration.

label: AgMsv_1.1093
cite_parts:
ata eva mṛto bālo vāsanāntaravarjitaḥ /
śiśur eva bhavet suptadṛḍhasaṃsāravāsanaḥ // [AgMsv_1.1093]
quick_english: For that reason, a child who dies without other impressions, but with firm worldly tendencies lying dormant, would be born again as an infant.

label: AgMsv_1.1094
cite_parts:
tānyau tathā (?) /
yāvadyauvanam abhyeti punas tadvāsanakramāt // [AgMsv_1.1094]
quick_english: In that way, by the sequence of those impressions, one reaches youth again and continues according to those same latent tendencies.

label: AgMsv_1.1095
cite_parts:
saṃskārasaṃvidā tās tāḥ saṃsṛtīr abhimanyate /
kaścij jaḍatvasaṃskārāj jaḍībhūto 'pi khānilaiḥ // [AgMsv_1.1095]
quick_english: Through cognition shaped by impressions, one takes various transmigrations to be real; and someone, through the impression of inertness, may even become inert while still associated with space and wind.

label: AgMsv_1.1096
cite_parts:
saha bhūjalayogena yāti puṣpaphalātmatām /
bhakṣito vīryarūpeṇa punar āyāti garbhatām // [AgMsv_1.1096]
quick_english: Joined with earth and water, one may become flower and fruit; eaten and transformed into seed, one may come again into the state of a womb.

label: AgMsv_1.1097
cite_parts:
yāvad punaḥ punaś citrān saṃsārān abhimanyate /
ekatraiva svasaṃskāravāsanāvāsitaḥ śivaḥ // [AgMsv_1.1097]
quick_english: Again and again, Śiva, dwelling in his own impressions and tendencies, takes varied worlds of transmigration to be real, all in one and the same place.

label: AgMsv_1.1098
cite_parts:
bhuṅkte svarnarakādyāṃs tu bhogān svātantryakalpitān /
kvacid bhūmimayī kvāpi jalātmā kvāpi miśritā // [AgMsv_1.1098]
quick_english: It experiences heavens, hells, and other enjoyments fashioned by its own freedom, appearing sometimes as earthy, sometimes as watery, and sometimes as mixed.

label: AgMsv_1.1099
cite_parts:
evaṃ bhuvanamayy eṣā saṃvid bhāti svarūpataḥ /
dhriyate yatra tatraiva svasaṃskārāt sukhādikam // [AgMsv_1.1099]
quick_english: Thus awareness shines by its own nature as made of worlds; wherever it is held, there, from its own impressions, it experiences pleasure and the like.

label: AgMsv_1.1100
cite_parts:
vetty anyena na dṛśyas tu sa tv anyān veda cānyathā /
na deśaḥ paramārthena na ca kālo 'sti kaś cana // [AgMsv_1.1100]
quick_english: One knows, but is not seen by another in that same way; one knows others differently. In ultimate truth, there is no place and no time at all.

label: AgMsv_1.1101
cite_parts:
bhedavāde hi gaganadeśāt sarvaikadeśatā /
upādher eva deśād bhiddeśasyāpy upādher bhidā // [AgMsv_1.1101]
quick_english: In the doctrine of difference, if space is the common place, everything would be in one place; but if difference comes from limiting conditions, even those differently placed conditions depend on further difference.

label: AgMsv_1.1102
cite_parts:
ity anyonyasamāśrityā deśabhedo na kaś cana /
svarūpabheda evāto bhedakatve susaṃgataḥ // [AgMsv_1.1102]
quick_english: Thus, because of mutual dependence, there is no real difference of place; only a difference of intrinsic nature would fit as a true differentiator.

label: AgMsv_1.1103
cite_parts:
sa ca nāsti prakāśaikasvarūpeṣv iti sādhitam /
enayaiva parāmarśadṛśā ye parivarjitāḥ // [AgMsv_1.1103]
quick_english: But that intrinsic difference does not exist in things whose nature is one light; this has already been established. Those who lack this reflective insight miss it.

label: AgMsv_1.1104
cite_parts:
te śaṅkākāriśāstraughaśaṅkitās tanmayīkṛtāḥ /
svasvapnanirmitānantajaḍajantuvikalpitaiḥ // [AgMsv_1.1104]
quick_english: Those deprived of that insight are made doubtful by floods of doubt-producing scriptures and become absorbed in them, taking as real the endless inert beings imagined in their own dreams.

label: AgMsv_1.1105
cite_parts:
śāstrābhāsair vṛthā śaṅkāṃ grāhyante bodhavarjitāḥ /
yathā prabuddhyante saṃvin nibhṛtāpi ciraṃ sthitā // [AgMsv_1.1105]
quick_english: Those without awakening are vainly made to cling to doubt by mere semblances of scripture; yet awareness, though hidden for long, can still awaken.

label: AgMsv_1.1106
cite_parts:
tathāpi phalatīty evaṃ prāyaś cittādikalpitaiḥ /
evam ābhāsanānātvasvātantryaiśvaryaśālinā // [AgMsv_1.1106]
quick_english: Even so, such things mostly bear fruit through constructions of the mind and the like, because of the sovereign freedom that manifests multiplicity.

label: AgMsv_1.1107
cite_parts:
kḷptaṃ yad eva tat tasya yāti tanvādirūpatām /
viparyayābhāsayoge śītādyābhāsadūṣite // [AgMsv_1.1107]
quick_english: Whatever is fashioned becomes for that person a body and the like; when joined with reversed appearances and tainted by sensations such as cold, it takes that disturbed form.

label: AgMsv_1.1108
cite_parts:
nāḍyādāv atha saṃkocasphoṭaghātādipīḍite /
dehabhastrāmahāyantravātacakre 'nyathāgate // [AgMsv_1.1108]
quick_english: Then, when the channels and so forth are afflicted by contraction, bursting, blows, and the like, the body—like a great bellows-machine with its wheel of winds—goes out of order.

label: AgMsv_1.1109
cite_parts:
prāṇo vighaṭate tena jaḍābhāsaṃ kalevaram /
yasmin yāty adhikāre vā jāte prāg vāsanākramāt // [AgMsv_1.1109]
quick_english: When the vital breath breaks apart, the body appears inert, and one passes into another sphere of experience that arises according to the sequence of earlier latent impressions.
